(short). I could have gotten two or three big hits. Happy that Russell did his job, and so 
did Rinku. The wicket is slow, and we have top quality-spinners, and if they can do (their 
job), we will be good to go. Thought I will stay there for a while and take the team 
through, hoping we can bowl well and win this game. Our fast bowlers are doing a really 
good job. The top two spinners are winning us games all the way, and backing our 
bowlers.

playoff dreams alive. Join us in a bit for the chase!

was the pick of the bunch and showed off his wares towards the end too, finishing with 
a four-wicket haul. Pathirana, who was expensive in his first three overs, also fought 
back well to ensure KKR did not cross 180.
